paite: Koute zaw Khrist nasemte leh Pathian thuguk kemte bang in min hon thei uhen.
heading: Khrist Sawltakte Mohpuakna
english: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

paite: Hiai ah kempa mimuanhuai hih akiphamoh ahi.
english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

paite: Himahleh nou na hon ettelna uh leh mihing ngaihtuahna a na hon ettelna uh kei a ding in thil neuchik ahi.
english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

paite: Keimah leng ka ki-entel ngei tuan kei. Bangmah kimohsakna ding ka kithei kei a; himahleh huai in siam hon tangsak tuan kei hi; hon entelpa Toupa ahi zaw hi.
english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

paite: Huchi in ahun ma in bangmah thukhenna bawl kei un, Toupa hong pai masiah, ama'n mial a thil selgukte vak ah hon lakhe ding a; lungtang a tupte leng ahihlang lai ding hi; huai hun chiang in michih in Pathian a kipan in amau tan hun chiat in phatna aloh chiat ding uhi.
english: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

paite: Unaute aw, na phattuampihna ding un hiai thu Apollos leh kei tung ah ka belh hi, huchi a koute a kipan a hindan na sintheihna ding uleh, akigelhsa pen sang a na lak ua kuamah mi khat midang sang a ngaina zaw a na kisaktheihpih louhna ding un.
english: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

paite: Kua'n ahia nou a thiltuam deuh om a mu? Na muhsawn louh ngal uh bang ahia na neih uh? Huchi a amusawn lel na hih uleh na muhsawn uh athawn a piak hilou bang a bangziak a kisathei zenzen?
english: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

paite: Tu in na vahta ua! Tu in na hong hauta ua! Kou lou in vai na hawmta uh! Ahi, vaihawm taktak le uchin, huchi a noute toh vai ka hawm sam theihna ding un.
english: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

paite: Pathian in kou sawltakte, si ding a sehsa bang in ananungpen in hon sepkhia hi in ka thei ahi; khovelte leh angelte leh mihingte mitmuh a etnop a bawl in ka om uhi.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

paite: Kou zaw Khrist ziak in mihai ka hi ua, nou bel Khrist ah mipil na hi zaw uhi; kou zaw ka hat kei ua, nou bel na hat uhi; nou zaw mi pahtawi in na om ua, kou zaw mi simmoh in ka om zaw uhi.
english: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

paite: Tutan in leng ka gilkial un ka dangtak ua, puansilh ka kiching kei ua, mi khut thak nuhna ka hi ua, mun leh mual ka nei kei uh;
english: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

paite: koumau khut a sem in ka gim mahmah ua; mi'n hon tai uleh ka vualzawl ua; ahon sawi uleh ka thuak teitei uhi.
english: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

paite: Mi'n hon gensiat uleh ka khem ua; tutan in leng khovel ninnok thil tengteng nin kihhuai bang in ahon bawl uhi.
english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

paite: Na zumna ding un hiai thu ka gelh ahi kei a, ka ta deihtakte bang a hon taihilh ding in ka gelh ahi zaw hi.
heading: Pa Bang A Thuhilhna Leh Vauna
english: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

paite: Khrist ah heutu singkhat nei mah le uchin, pa zaw tampi na nei tuan kei uhi. Ke'n Khrist Jesu ah tanchinhoih in noute ka hon neikhia hi.
english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

paite: Huaiziak in ka omdan zui ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

paite: Hiai ziak in Timothi, Toupa a ka ta deihtak leh muanhuai, na kiang uah ka hon sawl hi. Ama'n Khrist a ka omdan, gam chih a saptuamte teng thu ka hilh zeldan noute ahon theisak nawn ding hi.
english: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

paite: Huan kei na kiang ua hong nawn lou ding bang zen in khenkhat na na ki-uangsak uhi.
english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

paite: Himahleh Toupa'n pha asakleh sawt louchik nung in na kiang uah ka hong ding, huchi in miki-uangsakte kamhat thu hilou in, athilhihtheihna uh ka thei zawta ding hi.
english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

paite: Pathian lalgam zaw kamhat thu ah a-om kei a, thilhihtheihna ah a-om zaw hi.
english: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

paite: Bang na deihzaw ua? Chiangpum toh hia, itna leh kingaihniamna lungsim toh na kiang ua ka hong ding?
english: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
